steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Owooo... What shall I do...
The little girl sighs on a street corner of Syndicate.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: I can't believe that I can't find a single person who knows how to use a camera in all of Syndicate!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Same with that dummy clapper, who clearly made a promised to me with so much confidence, "I'll take care of it all."

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: But now I only get this... Hmph!
Disgruntled, the girl takes out an old door lock from her pocket.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: I knew it! The adorable OwO has to personally take the reins!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: It's just a photographer! Watch me conjure one up right here... woosh!
Please...
The long, drawn-out voice drifts into her ears.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Huh? What's that sound?
Please... move... aside!
A mysterious helmeted figure rushes towards her at full speed.
Thud!
With a loud thud, the two of them roll quite a distance across the ground before stopping, their belongings scattered all over.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Owooo... ouch, ouch... It hurts... Something hard hit me...
I... I'm sorry... If you're hurting real bad... I'll call an ambulance for you...

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Whoa! The Helmet Girl with the helmet is talking!

steps.speaker: Helmet Girl
steps.content: I... I'm not Helmet Girl! It was... an emergency... I had something really urgent... I'm very sorry for bumping into you...

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: All right... Since you apologized so earnestly, I'll forgive you this time! Don't do something so dangerous again!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: But... Can you tell me what the emergency was? Maybe I can use it as inspiration for my film...
Helmet Girl cuts OwO off halfway through her sentence.

steps.speaker: Helmet Girl
steps.content: Um... it's... Someone is chasing me...

steps.speaker: Helmet Girl
steps.content: If I get caught... I'll...

steps.speaker: Sheriff
steps.content: Don't let her escape! Catch her!

steps.speaker: Sheriff
steps.content: Catching the "Eastside Cyclops" will be a great accomplishment!
That voice is all too familiar to OwO. Having been in Syndicate for a while, she knows that aside from the gangsters, the only ones who'd shout so loudly are the sheriffs.

steps.speaker: Helmet Girl
steps.content: They... they're here! I'm leaving now!

steps.speaker: Helmet Girl
steps.content: Um... I'm really really sorry for crashing into you!
Helmet Girl bows deeply to OwO, then flees towards the abandoned industrial zone in the distance.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Hey! Where are you going... That way goes to the sewers!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: And you left your photos behind...

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Huh?! Photos?
OwO snatches up the photos from the ground and observes them carefully. They're mostly landscape photos, while very few featured people and animals.
Judging from the image quality, the photographer didn't use a fancy camera. Yet the photos have quite a tasteful ambiance.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Hmm... Not bad! I've decided. I'm going to recruit Helmet Girl!
OwO dusts herself off and heads towards the sewers.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Hmm... What to do about the sheriffs?

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Of course! Leave them to the dummy clapper!
A tattered helmet pokes out of the sewer opening.

steps.speaker: Helmet Girl
steps.content: Ha... They should be gone by now... right?

steps.speaker: Helmet Girl
steps.content: I didn't expect that it'd be the same even in Syndicate...

steps.speaker: Helmet Girl
steps.content: When can I escape this kind of life...

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Huh? Escape what kind of life? A perpetually helmeted life?

steps.speaker: Helmet Girl
steps.content: The same kind as the one I had in Eastside... Aaah!

steps.speaker: Helmet Girl
steps.content: You! W-why are you here?! I... I already apologized...

steps.speaker: Helmet Girl
steps.content: Don't hurt me...
Helmet Girl tries to run away again, but a paw firmly grabs her right hand.

steps.speaker: Helmet Girl
steps.content: Eek!
Moreover, the other paw is holding up a photo in front of her.
It's a landscape photo of Syndicate on a gilded afternoon.
It flutters freely in the wind, as if beckoning to Helmet Girl.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: This picture, and those too. Did you take all of these?
OwO points to the other photos. One of them shows a sunset in the Drifter Camp, while others feature cute pets.
Realizing that OwO is only interested in her photos, Helmet Girl becomes a lot more relieved.

steps.speaker: Helmet Girl
steps.content: Uh... Y-yes...

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Since you know how to snap pictures with that snappy camera, you should become the photographer for my great movies!

steps.speaker: Helmet Girl
steps.content: Huh? But... I just took these photos randomly for fun...

steps.speaker: Helmet Girl
steps.content: If you suddenly ask me to help make a movie or something... I'm really not up for the job...

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Don't worry! I have a sharp eye for talent! Helmet Girl, your photos are awesome, so your filming skills must be great, too!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Back where I come from, there's a saying... the apple... the apple... What happens to the apple again? Oh, the apple doesn't fall far from the tree! Wait... that's not right...

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Oh well, doesn't matter! Just hurry up and join my crew! Let's shake up DisCity's film industry together! Hahaha!

steps.speaker: Helmet Girl
steps.content: But... but...
Helmet Girl backs up a few steps from OwO's scorching gaze.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: My script, plus your camera skills! Our movie will definitely be a big hit in DisCity!

steps.speaker: Helmet Girl
steps.content: Don't... don't come over... ahhh!
Seeing that Helmet Girl is about to flee again, OwO has no choice but to use her trump card.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: There's more! If you join my crew, I'll make custom scripts just for you!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Hehe! OwO's incredible scripts are like no other!

steps.speaker: Helmet Girl
steps.content: I... really couldn't tell...
Though Helmet Girl doesn't say it out loud, the confident, chest-thumping OwO has elicited her curiosity.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: My scripts are S-Class scripts! As long as we get a cast, we'll be sure to go down in cinematic history!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Come come... Sit down, Helmet Girl. Ahem, let me tell you about my vision!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Even if you don't want to join now, you'll definitely change your mind after hearing about my incredible script!
OwOs pats the cement pipe beside her, motioning for Helmet Girl to sit next to her.

steps.speaker: Helmet Girl
steps.content: R-really?
Helmet Girl warily sits down next to OwO.

steps.speaker: Helmet Girl
steps.content: Then... What is the script about...?

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: I've decided to make a movie about "courage"!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: What's your name, by the way?

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: The protagonist has got to have a name.
OwO takes out a storyboard from her lion's head, then looks at Helmet Girl as if she suddenly remembered something.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: Lynn. My name is Lynn.
